text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho attracts the
strongest
competitors, and summer camp
is where everyone
hopes to achieve
incredible gains in the lead-up
to it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Originally, I wasn't expecting to rise
through the
ranks at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But startin' today, it's no longer a futile
struggle.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That said, there's still a limit to how
much I can
improve.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm not like the new generation, with
their heads
full of ambit—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: 'Sup.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay for a sheltered little
princess like
yourself to be out in this
kind of heat?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, quit that, Shakur. You know I'm
debuting,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: With strings attached, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You know I'm an exchange student,
right? I have
permission to race for three
years and then I have
to return.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But I intend to enjoy the time I've been
given to
the fullest. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'd be so happy if we could
race each
other here at camp, Shakur.
Please and thank
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she talks about her situation
casually, I
wonder how it feels to know
the end is coming
from the very
beginning. Not only that...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: How so? In what way?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
She actually knows and fully grasps her
future,
but in a completely different way
than me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: She's... already accepted hers.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Exactly.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Not like it's anything to do with me,
though. At
any rate, even if you take
one person out of the
equation, there's
an endless amount of people to
replace
them.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you take a good look around
the
camp. Gathering data isn't a walk in
the park so
try and pull your weight,
okay?
